description_en: Modifies the configuration of a protection rule
description_zh: 修改防护规则配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-rule --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --rules id_:_2344,_policyId_:_1012,_action_:_block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDefenseRule

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection rule template.
This parameter is required only when DefenseType is set to template
parameters.help_zh:
防护规则模板ID。
仅当 DefenseType 为 template 时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The protection scenario to modify. For more information, see the DefenseScene parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的防护场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html的**DefenseScene**参数
parameters.name: defense_scene

parameters.help_en:
The details of the protection rule. The value is a string that is converted from a JSON object constructed by a series of parameters. When you configure this parameter, you must specify the rule ID and the protection rule configuration to modify. The following parameters are included:

id: Long | Required | The rule ID.

Protection rule configuration: Same as the Rules parameter of the CreateDefenseRule operation. For more information, see the protection rule parameter description in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html
parameters.help_zh:
防护规则详情，以一系列参数构造的JSON格式转化成字符串。配置时，您需要指定规则ID，并设置要修改的防护规则配置信息。具体包括：

id：Long类型 | 必选 | 规则ID。

防护规则配置信息：与CreateDefenseRule接口的Rules参数相同。相关描述，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html的**防护规则参数描述**
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en: The type of the protection rule
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The protected object associated with the rule to modify.
This parameter is required only when DefenseType is set to resource
parameters.help_zh:
修改规则对应的防护对象。
仅当 DefenseType 为 resource 时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: resource
